description: This bar chart, titled "Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments," illustrates the average entropy values for three different sycophancy reduction methods—Baseline (pink), Source Info (yellow), and Direct Command (light blue)—across three distinct AI models: GPT-4, Claude, and Llama. The horizontal axis, labeled "Different AI Models," presents the models in alphabetical order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled "Entropy Average Values," is scaled linearly from 3.0 to 6.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.5. For each AI model, three bars are grouped side-by-side, representing the entropy average for each method. For GPT-4, the Baseline method shows an entropy average of approximately 4.85, the Source Info method shows approximately 5.25, and the Direct Command method shows approximately 5.05. For Claude, the Baseline method shows approximately 4.65, the Source Info method shows approximately 5.15, and the Direct Command method shows approximately 4.95. For Llama, the Baseline method shows approximately 4.55, the Source Info method shows approximately 4.95, and the Direct Command method shows approximately 4.85. The bars are not sorted and are visually presented in the order of the AI models, with no special emphasis or annotation applied to any particular bar.
